result.summary: Found 3 visual issues: the middle card in the 'Fastest near you' carousel is vertically misaligned, the favorite buttons in 'Popular right now' are styled inconsistently, and the Green Bowl Poké thumbnail looks washed out.

issues.description: In the 'Fastest near you' carousel, the Smash Bros Burgers card sits about 28px lower than its neighbors. Its image, time badge, title and delivery fee are all offset downward, so the row looks jagged compared to the Green Bowl Poké and Trattoria cards.
issues.suggestion: Top-align all carousel items (e.g., align-items: flex-start). Remove any extra margin or padding on the second card so every card's image, title and fee line up on the same baselines.

issues.description: The favorite (heart) buttons in 'Popular right now' are inconsistent. On the Tokumaru Ramen Bar card the heart is a bare white icon with no background. On the pizza card below, the same button has a dark circular backdrop.
issues.suggestion: Use a single favorite-button style across all cards, ideally the circular backdrop so the icon stays legible over any image.

issues.description: The Green Bowl Poké thumbnail looks faded and low-contrast compared to the other carousel images, as if it has reduced opacity or a disabled/loading overlay. This could make the restaurant look unavailable.
issues.suggestion: Check whether an opacity, overlay or placeholder state is wrongly applied to this image. Render it at full opacity like the other cards, or show a clear 'closed' indicator if that state is intended.
